subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Man’s dignity is to work for others Man depends upon his words He should a rational being on earth He not be proud if he is of blue blood He be ready to help any class of man
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Man’s dignity depends depends upon his words. (ii) Man is a rational being on earth. (iii) He is to work for others. (iv) He should not be proud if he is of blue blood. (v) He should be ready to help any class of man.
